description:
My other Rus build orders:
- 2 TC (Golden Gate): https://aoe4guides.com/builds/pX8L4VhAZGmjAxDgvCcN
- Feudal aggro: https://aoe4guides.com/builds/xfOIBbmMKAFgdR96BV7i
name: Rus | 2 TC (golden gate)
author: siberian_wolf

notes: 1@unit_worker/villager.webp@from@resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@build @building_economy/lumber-camp.webp@on woodline and shift click to woodline
Remacro @resource/rally.webp@to sheep once 12@unit_worker/villager.webp@ are on wood
2@unit_worker/villager.webp@ from woodline to build @building_rus/wooden-fortress.webp@ on woodline, then back to wood

From here wall if you can, maybe build @building_rus/hunting-cabin.webp@ in the far woods, and castle with 8@unit_worker/villager.webp@ from sheep on@landmark_rus/high-trade-house.webp@ , then prolly horse archer spam idk.
1@unit_worker/villager.webp@from@resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@build @building_economy/lumber-camp.webp@on woodline and shift click to woodline
Remacro @resource/rally.webp@to sheep once 12@unit_worker/villager.webp@ are on wood
Build second @unit_cavalry/scout.webp@ from @building_rus/hunting-cabin.webp@ if needed. Scout for Deer Packs for @landmark_rus/kremlin.webp@ placement.
Take all but 4@unit_worker/villager.webp@ and put them on @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@, then @resource/rally.webp@@resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@ until 8.

The 5 @unit_worker/villager.webp@ that aged up will immediately build @building_military/stable.webp@, then to @resource/deer.webp@. Try to push the @resource/deer.webp@ towards @landmark_rus/kremlin.webp@ with your @unit_cavalry/scout.webp@.

Once 8 @unit_worker/villager.webp@@resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@ have finished gathering from the 3@resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@, send all but one to @resource/resource_gold.webp@. The other will build @building_economy/lumber-camp.webp@ within influence of the Kremlin.
Make  @unit_cavalry/knight-2.webp@ (anywhere from 1-4 depending on matchup), and get @technology_economy/survival-techniques.webp@ whenever you can.
Use your @unit_cavalry/knight-2.webp@ to harass the opponent while you age up to Castle.

Build @landmark_rus/abbey-of-the-trinity.webp@ with 8-12 @unit_worker/villager.webp@@resource/resource_food.webp@, depending on how fast you need to get @resource/relics.webp@. Send to @resource/resource_wood.webp@ after.
Send 5@resource/resource_food.webp@@unit_worker/villager.webp@ to @resource/resource_wood.webp@, @resource/rally.webp@@resource/resource_wood.webp@ for rest of the game.
Get @technology_economy/double-broadaxe.webp@ and @technology_economy/wheelbarrow.webp@. Set @resource/rally.webp@ for @landmark_rus/abbey-of-the-trinity.webp@ to get @resource/relics.webp@.
Immediately queue @unit_rus/warrior-monk.webp@ to get @resource/relics.webp@. Make more @unit_cavalry/knight-2.webp@.
Send 8@resource/resource_wood.webp@@unit_worker/villager.webp@ to a food source, like @resource/deer.webp@. Build a @building_rus/wooden-fortress.webp@.

If opponent is heavy on @unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@, make @unit_infantry/archer-2.webp@. If they are heavy on @unit_cavalry/knight-2.webp@ or @unit_infantry/man-at-arms-1.webp@, make @unit_infantry/crossbowman-3.webp@. Make @unit_rus/horse-archer-3.webp@ if you need mobility and are ready to micro
Keep producing @unit_rus/warrior-monk.webp@! You want at least 5 at all times to buff your units and capture sacred sites.

Use your @unit_cavalry/knight-2.webp@ to keep harassing, while massing @unit_infantry/archer-2.webp@ / @unit_rus/horse-archer-3.webp@ / @unit_infantry/crossbowman-3.webp@ and getting all Economic upgrades and @building_technology/blacksmith.webp@ upgrades.
Once you're floating around 300@resource/resource_wood.webp@, take some  of those vills and put them on a @resource/resource_food.webp@ source.
Aim to have 10-15 on @resource/resource_wood.webp@ at all times, moving any extra to @resource/resource_food.webp@.

Once you've gotten all your @resource/relics.webp@ and capped the @resource/sacred_sites.webp@, take all your @resource/resource_gold.webp@@unit_worker/villager.webp@ and put them on either @resource/resource_food.webp@ or @resource/resource_wood.webp@.
Build a lot of extra @building_economy/house.webp@ for Kremlin Militia to come out
Use Levy all militia from @landmark_rus/kremlin.webp@, and go for timing attack on enemy.
